effect.scp_unleashed.amnestic.descriptio: Whatever you look away from stays with you a moment too long.
SCP-939, "With Many Voices": eyeless red predators that hunt in packs. Keter-class.
They find prey by sound and smell. Quiet steps carry less far than running ones, and bright light seems to put them off.
They copy the voices of what they have eaten, and use them to draw others close.
Their breath clouds the mind. Long or repeated exposure leaves effects that build on each other.
They never spawn naturally. Their file comes from the Archive.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp939.0: Something calls for help from a cave. Don't answer it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.title: With Many Voices
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.caption: SCP-939 instances in their cell. The blur in this photograph is not a fault of the camera.
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.0.text.0: SCP-939 is held in a sealed, windowless cell of modest size. Doors and vents stay shut while instances are present, and the cell is kept dimly lit.
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.0.text.1: **Respirators are to be worn inside the cell.** Staff who report lost time or doubled vision after a shift are to be relieved.
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.0.text.2: Instances are fed live livestock. Voices from the cell are to be ignored, whoever they seem to belong to.
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.0.text.3: Unidentified individuals found inside the cell are to be isolated. %rSee Addendum 939-3.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.1.text.0: SCP-939 are eyeless pack predators larger than a big dog, with raw red skin, long clawed limbs and a ridge of bony spines. They hunt by sound, smell and the warmth of breath.
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.1.text.1: Instances copy the voices of animals and people they have eaten, usually to lure others closer. The copies are close, but subtly wrong.
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.1.text.2: Their breath carries AMN-C227, a colourless amnestic. Exposure blurs and doubles vision and erodes short-term memory, and the effects build on earlier exposure. Instances avoid bright light.
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.2.title: Addendum 939-1: AMN-C227
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.2.text: AMN-C227 can be drawn from an occupied cell and compressed. Recipients reported that it prolonged other treatments of the mind, and that its visual side effects worsened with each dose. %rThe program was suspended.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.3.title: Addendum 939-2: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.3.text: SCP-939 were found in a cave after a reader of this file followed coordinates no one had written. The team heard someone below calling for help. %rNo one was missing.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.4.title: Addendum 939-3: Headcount
dossier.scp_unleashed.939.page.4.text: Small children have been found unharmed inside the cell. None could say how they got there, and each grew restless within days of being found. The headcount has risen since. %rLogs restricted.%r
